name: xiaoyuzhou-transcription
title_zh: 小宇宙链接进来，出去的是带发言人标记的逐字稿
tagline_zh: 别再手动拖音频、找转写工具了。贴个播客链接，它自己抽音轨、跑ASR，按说话人分段，还附要点总结和问答。
tagline_en: Stop manually extracting audio and hunting for transcribers. Paste a podcast link—it pulls the track, runs ASR.
desc_en: Transcribe 小宇宙 (Xiaoyuzhou) podcast episodes to text with structured summaries. Extracts audio from a 小宇宙 link, runs Qwen ASR transcription, formats a speaker-segmented verbatim transcript, and generates key-point summaries and Q&A. Use when a user shares a 小宇宙 podcast link, requests 播客转录 (podcast transcription), 音频转文字 (audio-to-text), 逐字稿 (verbatim transcript), or 播客内容总结 (podcast content summary)
why_zh: 不是简单转文字：它把音频抽取、ASR识别、说话人分段、要点提炼串成一条流水线，你只给链接。
why_en: Not just speech-to-text: it chains audio extraction, ASR, speaker segmentation, and summarization into one pipeline. You drop a.
limit_zh: 只认小宇宙单集链接，不支持合集或分P。ASR用Qwen，对重口音、多人抢话、背景音嘈杂的段落会识别错乱。
limit_en: Accepts only single Xiaoyuzhou episode links, not playlists or multi-part. Qwen ASR may garble heavy accents, crosstalk, or noisy segments; speaker.
title_en: Xiaoyuzhou link in, speaker-tagged transcript out
